_readme: Built by scratch/build-late-eras.py out of sources/wayback/raw, with no network access: the columns each site era published beyond the name the wayback layer keeps. 2007-2012 is the Current Investments table (description, location, status, ticker, acquirer). 2015-2020 is the WordPress card grid, whose <article> class list carries the firm's own sector and stage taxonomies, an active_state and the deal partner's author slug (the same slugs as /author/<slug>, so they join to the roster). 2021-2026 is the Gatsby grid's data-filter attributes. Every stage field here is the FIRM'S OWN LABEL and is scored on the golden set before it is trusted (COLLECTION.md 4).
